newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea to open mission in Cambodia next week.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea to open mission in Cambodia next week.

text.p: The South Korean foreign ministry said on Thursday that the country will open its representative office in Cambodia on September 16.
The two countries agreed on the office in May as a step towards resuming full diplomatic relations, which were severed in 1975.
The office was expected to serve 200 South Korean residents in Cambodia and promote South Korean businesses, the ministry said.
